standard.title: Evaluating
standard.description: compare observations with predictions and others' observations, consider if investigations are fair and identify further questions with guidance
standard.prior_knowledge: Students have made observations and predictions (F band). They now begin to compare these with others and consider fairness — guided by the teacher.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students compare their observations with predictions and with others' observations, consider with guidance whether an investigation was fair, and identify further questions prompted by their observations.

nodes.label: Observations are compared with predictions and others
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can compare their observation with their prediction (did it match?) and compare their observation with another student's observation, identifying at least one similarity or difference.
nodes.minimum_width: Students compare their observation with their prediction and with one other student's observation.
nodes.typical_width: Students compare observations with predictions across investigations; compare observations with others (bird counts, plant growth, object movement); consider whether differences might be due to an unfair investigation; and identify one further question prompted by an unexpected observation.
wider: Consult with First Nations Australians to compare observations and evaluate identifications of animal tracks — examining how knowledge of Country informs observation comparison
Explore if making weather observations at different times of day makes a difference — considering fairness of comparison
Compare how far an object travels with different students pushing and discuss how to make the investigation fairer
success_criteria: Compares observation with prediction and states whether it matched
Compares observation with at least one other student's and identifies a similarity or difference
